candidate.not_claimed: not a complete reproduction of the preprint; the paper's continuous motion and continuous-time feedback are not modelled

task_semantics.pending: Q = (P - C) and F, with P published, C the real coverage history, F free
task_semantics.deferred: D = (P - C) - F; kept, never counted as completed, never flown into
task_semantics.motion: four-neighbour unit steps over F only
task_semantics.coverage: arriving on a pending target covers it physically (transit counts)
task_semantics.history: C is real and never reset for this round; covered and non-target free cells stay passable
task_semantics.end: the route must end at the base
task_semantics.resource: route_steps must fit the remaining budget when one is given

two_ledgers.control: MAPS state; U means control-pending, not physically uncollected; updated only when the ETM tasks a cell in WT
two_ledgers.physical: recomputed by the independent auditor from the saved route
two_ledgers.tasking: a logical task updates control state only; it adds no time, steps or energy, and re-visiting a cell never counts as a new completion

timing.public_call: from the adapter entry to the finished pre-return audit; covers input checks, MAPS construction, the ETM loop, every connector call, the return leg and the audit
timing.ledger: the two-phase ledger write and its fsync happen outside the measured algorithm time; the registry records the outer wall time separately
timing.process: the subprocess start-up is measured by the parent and reported apart
timing.event_times: all event times are relative to the same public entry

deadline.checks: before MAPS, every control iteration, before and after each connector call, before the return leg, during the return, and before the audit
deadline.candidate_boundary: generated -> audited -> accepted; a route whose audit finishes after the deadline is diagnostic only
deadline.semantics: cooperative; a single BFS row may overrun slightly and is reported

rng_use: choice among equipotential coarse blocks at a level
choice of an unexplored cell inside the selected block
choice among equal-cost waypoint candidates of Eq. (5)
tie_breaking.deterministic_order: waypoint sets and blocks are sorted before any choice
tie_breaking.cost_units: travel_cost per step, turn_cost per degree from the heading; 90 degrees therefore costs 90 travel units

status_map.finished: natural FN, route legal, complete, returned, within resource
status_map.finished_with_safety_limit: artificial stop (iteration cap / state cycle / no progress) but a legal complete route was audited before the deadline
status_map.deadline_before_complete_route: no route was accepted before the deadline
status_map.environment_infeasible: base or a pending target is unreachable from the start
status_map.resource_exceeded: legal and complete but the route exceeds the budget
status_map.coverage_incomplete: the route does not visit every pending target

stop_rules.per_call: soft deadline, hard watchdog, control-iteration cap
stop_rules.batch: stop if a semantic violation appears in the integration batch
stop_rules.round: stop at 96 full planner calls or at any unresolved source problem

not_in_this_round: no development map, no 300-run comparison, no other method
no holdout, no parameter sweep, no second control-frequency version
